Triage:定级 **`needs-user-decision` · Bug**(CI/发布通道策略 + 潜在 token 信任面,人工地板,超出代裁边界)。四维分析:

① **项目长远合理性**:release 提交是每周落上 `main` 的最大单笔 diff(371 文件 / 39 包),且是唯一绕过合并队列验证的通道 —— 修通道优于逐产物打补丁。选项 A(在 `changeset-release.yml` 里对 version 之后的树跑验证)把验证放在恰好要落地的那棵树上,零新增信任面;选项 B(PAT/GitHub App token 让 release PR 跑真 checks)扩大供应链信任面并新增 token 生命周期义务;选项 C(接受现状 + 逐产物机械保证)不可泛化 —— PR #5396 只救了一行。
② **实际业务拉动**:已三次真实付账(#5394 的同一文档行三次漂移上 main);客户可感知后果是 release 提交把 `main` 弄红后,首个报信的是 ~39 分钟的 push build,期间全部车道的合并队列压在红 main 上 —— 一次事故 ≈ 全团队小时级停摆。
③ **防 AI 犯错**:371 文件的机器生成 diff 免验落 main,恰是「机器产出需响亮门禁」的教科书场景;A 在生成点验证,结构性堵住,而非依赖人看 push build。
④ **创业阶段不扩散**:A 复用既有 job 与既有 test/build 命令,零新基础设施;B 引入需轮换、可泄漏的凭据。

**推荐:A**(version 步之后、action 开/更新 PR 之前,对 post-version 树跑验证)。选项:**A** 如上 / **B** PAT/App token 换真 PR checks / **C** 接受现状,逐产物机械保证。

**本分析看不见什么**:A 的真实价格未测 —— `changesets/action` 在每次 push to main 时都会刷新 release PR,post-version 全量 test+build(本仓 ~40 分钟)是否要为每次 main push 付一遍?若是,A 需要一个「仅 release PR 内容变化时才验证」的缓存/条件层,其复杂度本分析未定价。另:objectstack / cloud / objectos 是否同病(同一 action + GITHUB_TOKEN 形态)未审计 —— 裁决若采 A,应顺带普查四仓。

## Maintainer ruling recorded (2026-08-22, decision-inbox digest with the skills seat, `session_01ApyDuQY2fkunMCqXiqvBhR`)

The full decision inbox (46 cards) was presented with per-card four-axis recommendations; the maintainer accepted the batch, verbatim: 「接受所有」.

**Ruled:** Option A — run the version step's validation inside `changeset-release.yml`, on the post-version tree, after the version step and before `changesets/action` opens/updates the release PR. This validates exactly the tree that lands on `main` with zero new token/trust surface (rejecting B's PAT/App-token route and C's per-artifact mechanical guarantees). Attached condition, per the recommendation's stated blind spot: price/measure the cost first — determine whether the post-version full test+build (~40 min) would be paid on every push to `main` that refreshes the release PR, and whether a validate-only-when-release-PR-content-changes conditional/cache layer is needed, before committing to the implementation shape.

State: `needs-user-decision` removed → `pm:queue` (ready for dispatch).

## PM claim + dispatch order — R27. ⭐ The fold-or-serial question triage required is now **moot**, checked rather than inherited.

Claimed by the `domain:devx` @ objectui execution seat (#5748), PM session `session_019b5UBNMtTzKbVtZZGvFuxe`. Branch: `claude/issue-5397-release-pr-validation`.

### The serial constraint has expired

Triage (2026-08-23) required an answer before dispatch:

> ⚠️ this card, **#5442** (releases that never reached npm) and **#5571** (Version Packages refresh cadence) are three readings of the same release pipeline and will contend for `.github/workflows/`. Fold-or-serial is a required answer.

Measured now, both siblings are **closed and landed**:

- **#5442** — closed 2026-08-24 14:38Z, by **PR #5774 (MERGED)**, *"key the publish lane on npm presence, not on pending changesets"*.
- **#5571** — closed 2026-08-23 05:36Z.

So there is no contention left to serialise against, and this card dispatches **alone**. ⛔ Do not fold anything into it.

⚠️ **But the file has still moved under this card.** PR #6173 (card #6081) edited `.github/workflows/changeset-release.yml` **tonight** — it deleted the mirror and `pending_changesets`, and made the clear step conditional on `github.event_name == 'push'`. Re-read the workflow as it now stands; ⛔ do not trust any quotation of it in this card, which is from 2026-08-20.

### The ruling: **option A**, and it carries a binding pre-condition

Maintainer ruling (2026-08-22, 「接受所有」): run the version step's validation **inside `changeset-release.yml`**, on the **post-version tree**, after the version step and before `changesets/action` opens or updates the release PR. That validates exactly the tree that lands on `main`, with **zero new token or trust surface**.

⛔ **B is rejected** — a PAT / GitHub App token widens the supply-chain trust surface and adds credential-rotation obligations. ⛔ **C is rejected** — per-artifact mechanical guarantees do not generalise; PR #5396 saved exactly one doc row.

### ⭐ The attached condition is the first half of the work, not a caveat

The ruling explicitly attaches the recommendation's own stated blind spot:

> **price/measure the cost first** — determine whether the post-version full test+build (~40 min) would be paid on **every push to `main`** that refreshes the release PR, and whether a validate-only-when-release-PR-content-changes conditional/cache layer is needed, **before committing to the implementation shape**.

**Measure that before you write the workflow edit, and report the number.** `changesets/action` refreshes the release PR on every push to `main`, and this repo takes ~18 merges a day. If naive option A pays a 40-minute full validation on each, that is ~12 hours of runner time daily for a PR nobody consumes until release day — which is the exact cost #5571 was closed to remove, reintroduced through a different door.

⭐ **If the measurement says the conditional layer is needed, that layer IS the card** — design it, price it, and say so. ⛔ Do not ship naive option A and leave the cost unmeasured; the ruling forbids exactly that ordering.

### Why it matters, for the workflow's header comment

The release commit is the **largest single diff** landing on `main` in any week (371 files / 39 packages), machine-generated, and the **only** commit reaching `main` without merge-queue validation. Measured: 736 `ci.yml` runs on `changeset-release/main`, every recent one `action_required` with `created_at == run_started_at == updated_at` — created and immediately parked, nothing executed. On the 17.6.0 release PR the check-runs endpoint returned `total_count: 1`, a single job starting **7 seconds after the merge**.

The mechanism: GitHub does not start workflow runs from events raised by `GITHUB_TOKEN`, and the bot force-pushes `changeset-release/main` on every push to `main`, so there is no stable head for a human to re-run against either.

### Verification

- ⛔ **Do not execute a release.** All evidence gathered read-only against the Actions API, as the card itself did.
- ⚠️ You cannot test this by merging a release PR. State plainly how far you validated and what remains unobserved until the next real release — ⛔ do not claim end-to-end proof you cannot have.
- Re-measure the `action_required` reading on today's runs; if it has changed, that is the finding.

### Scope

`.github/workflows/changeset-release.yml` and whatever the conditional layer needs. ⛔ Do not touch the publish path's semantics — PR #5774 just re-keyed it on npm presence, and this card validates a tree; it does not change what publishes.

⭐ **Out of scope, worth filing rather than doing**: the triage analysis notes that `objectstack` / `cloud` / `objectos` may have the identical `changesets/action` + `GITHUB_TOKEN` shape and were **never audited**. If your reading confirms the mechanism is generic, **file a card** naming the sweep. ⛔ Do not audit them here.

Exit codes captured by redirect before any pipe. ⚠️ Derive the gate list from `package.json` and `.github/workflows/` rather than from this order. ⭐ Derive which tests read `changeset-release.yml` and run them — `scripts/__tests__/changeset-release-action-ref-pin.test.ts` exists and was strengthened by PR #6173 tonight; there is also a `ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` that mechanically requires every workflow to have a heading in `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`.

## H8 配对写入：`pm:dispatched` → `pm:awaiting-maintainer`

交付 PR **#6217 已于 2026-08-25T02:40:53Z 合并**，本卡仍挂 `pm:dispatched`，已挂 **5.5 天**。

按 dev report（`5404145880`）的 `open_questions` 定级 —— 卡上留着一个**未裁的政策问题**，且它已按推荐值发布：

> 验证跑红时，refresh 应该被**阻断**（PR 保留上次通过验证的内容），还是**照常刷新只让这次 run 变红**？已按 **A（阻断）** 发布；这是政策选择，不是技术选择。

dev 的理由是 A 的失败模式是响的（每 6 小时红一次）而 B 会让 PR 承载已知红树；同时明说 **B 是站得住的**，如果你更看重「PR 始终反映 main」。⇒ 这是你的一句话决定，故 `pm:awaiting-maintainer`。

已交付部分不受影响：refresh 车道现在会渲染 post-version 树、验证、再还原，成本按范围收敛到 **+约 68 秒/次（约 4.5 分钟/天）**，而不是朴素 A 的约 2.7 小时/天。

本笔是维护者指令下的 H8 清账（2026-08-30，session `session_014kugUSM5M5fJBsk1f8KdtN`）：⛔ 未改卡面范围、未动 assignee。

## Maintainer ruling recorded — A: a red post-version validation blocks the refresh; the shipped behaviour is confirmed and the card closes completed

Director seat (objectstack #12708), summon #8, session `session_01ShyhexkB2d1AeRZ85tgAAe`, 2026-09-02.

The 2026-08-22 ruling (option A, validate the post-version tree inside `changeset-release.yml`) is delivered: PR #6217 merged 2026-08-25, cost priced first and scoped to +~68 s per refresh. The open item was the policy question the implementer flagged and shipped at its recommended value: on a red validation, block the refresh (the standing PR keeps its last validated content and the run goes red every 6 hours), or refresh anyway and only fail the run.

Provenance (who / verbatim / where): maintainer, live PM chat with the director seat, 2026-09-02, replying to decision batch #9 in which this card was item 5 with the recommendation A (confirm the shipped behaviour; B not recommended). Verbatim reply: 「其他同意」 — A confirmed.

**Ruled: A.** The refresh lane never force-pushes `changeset-release/main` to a tree that failed validation. A stale release PR is recoverable by one `workflow_dispatch` with `refresh_version_pr` once the tree is fixed; an unvalidated force-push is the defect this card was filed for. Option B is not taken.

Nothing further is owed here. The sibling finding for objectstack (identical no-CI release PR shape, strictly larger post-version diff, scope conclusion does not transfer) is objectstack#11945.

State transition, same stroke: `pm:awaiting-maintainer` stripped; the card closes **completed**. Ledger: objectstack director seat post #12708, summon #8.
